sourceExtractor.method: Static relative import/export graph including multiline declarations, type imports, side-effect imports and literal import()/require().
limits: Package internals, dynamic/computed module specifiers and filesystem Bun.build entrypoints are outside the extractor. No such changed entrypoint is used for the retained-pass comparisons here.
Explicit import type/export type edges are annotated. Mixed imports are conservatively treated as value edges; runtime dependence is therefore an overapproximation.
The changed module is analyzed at file granularity. A value import of another unchanged export from that module is conservatively affected; runtime symbol coverage is not inferred.
